### Feature / Model Overview
Is your feature request related to a specific alloy system, thermodynamic model, or CAE feature?

### Physical Justification & Literature References
Provide exact peer-reviewed paper citations (Author, Year, Journal, DOI) supporting the proposed calculation model or empirical dataset.

### Proposed Implementation
Describe how this model should fit into the existing architecture:
- Target engine: `HEAThermoEngine`, `HEAMechanicalEngine`, `HEAOxidationEngine`, `HEAXRDEngine`, or UI
- How the result should be plotted or tabulated in the OriginLab-style canvas

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.
